+import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config';
+
+/**
+ * Vitest config for the cross-cutting connector smoke suite (KS-2182, KS-1398 step one, lane L2b).
+ * It replaces the Jest config this directory used: ts-jest cannot run on TypeScript 7.
+ * Lives in tests/connectors/ so per-service configs aren't disturbed.
+ *
+ * Run via `npm run test:connectors` from the Blockchain/Dev root, which is
+ * `vitest run --root tests/connectors`. THE `--root` IS LOAD-BEARING: Vitest's root defaults to the
+ * current directory, so `--config tests/connectors/vitest.config.ts` alone, run from Blockchain/Dev,
+ * sweeps every *.test.ts under Blockchain/Dev (measured: it also ran a decoy test outside this
+ * directory).
+ *
+ * All tests are skipped by default unless their required env vars are set (see _helpers.ts and
+ * README.md); four suites declare no required variables and run.
+ *
+ * The test files call describe, test and expect as globals with no import, so `globals: true` is
+ * required (every vitest.config.ts in this repo sets it).
+ *
+ * Carried over from the Jest config: a '!' at the start of a glob segment is a negation to
+ * micromatch, and a repo living under a directory like '!CODING/' broke Jest's testMatch
+ * (discovered 2026-04-29 during the E2E sweep). This `include` is relative to the root and was
+ * measured under a path that contains '!CODING': all 20 test files were found.
+ */
+export default defineConfig({
+  test: {
+    globals: true,
+    environment: 'node',
+    include: ['**/*.test.ts'],
+    testTimeout: 15000,
+  },
+});

The 20 test files did not change. The root package.json now declares vitest (^4.1.12) and the root lock gained 24 optional @rollup/rollup-* platform entries and nothing else. +
Proof: same counts before and after, 4 suites passed and 16 skipped of 20, 5 tests passed and 17 skipped of 22; a planted failing assertion exits 1; npm run test:connectors -- smtp-email still selects one file; npm run audit:gate exits 0 on the new lock and 1 on a planted vulnerable entry. +

Keep the --root. Vitest's root defaults to the current directory: without --root tests/connectors a run from Blockchain/Dev sweeps every *.test.ts under it. npm run audit:locks does not scan the root lock; use npm run audit:gate for a root-lock change. +
+
+
Not measured here. A credentialed run (every test asserts true), type-checking of these test files (esbuild checks no types), Node 24, a container build, and the four platform suites. +

. KS-2182 (KS-1398 step one, lane L2b): the connector smoke suite runs on Vitest instead of Jest

+
What this changes. Blockchain/Dev/tests/connectors/ ran on Jest through ts-jest, which cannot run on TypeScript 7. It now runs on Vitest 4.1.12: a new tests/connectors/vitest.config.ts (globals on, node environment, every *.test.ts under the directory, a 15,000 ms timeout), and the root npm run test:connectors is now vitest run --root tests/connectors. tests/connectors/jest.config.cjs is removed in the same commit (git history keeps it). The 20 *.test.ts files, _helpers.ts, README.md, check-coverage.mjs and connectors.registry.json are byte for byte unchanged. No TypeScript version changes. +
Why this route. The suite uses describe, test and expect as globals with no import, so globals: true is all it needs (every vitest.config.ts in the repository sets it) and no test file is edited. The --root is load-bearing: Vitest's root defaults to the current directory, so a run from Blockchain/Dev with only --config tests/connectors/vitest.config.ts sweeps every *.test.ts under Blockchain/Dev (measured: 21 files, a decoy test outside the directory ran). +
+

.1 The root manifest and the root lock

+
Two lines in the root package.json. The test:connectors script, and a vitest devDependency at ^4.1.12. The root declared no test runner before: the script resolved jest and ts-jest only by hoisting from workspaces, and vitest already sat in the lock the same way. +
The root lock moves by a measured, additive set. The root entry gains the vitest line, and 24 optional @rollup/rollup-* platform entries at 4.60.4 are added (npm completes rollup's optional platform binaries once vite is reached from a direct root dependency). Nothing is removed and no other entry changes: 1,931 entries become 1,955, a text diff of 352 added and 0 removed lines. The command is npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts from Blockchain/Dev; a run with no manifest change leaves the lock byte for byte identical, and a second run after the change is byte equal to the first. +
Which audit sees it. npm run audit:locks does not scan the root lock (its own line says the workspace root is covered by audit-gate); npm run audit:gate does. A planted vulnerable entry in a scratch copy of the lock leaves audit:locks at exit 0 and turns audit:gate to exit 1. +
+

.2 TypeScript 7.0.2 in a scratch copy

+
A measurement, not a gate. In a scratch copy with typescript@7.0.2 installed beside Vitest 4.1.12, npm run test:connectors exits 0 with the same counts as on 5.9.3. Nothing was installed in the tree for this. +

.4 What this does not prove

What was not driven. A credentialed run (every test is a placeholder that asserts true, so a green run with credentials proves nothing about a connector, as docs/CONNECTORS_PATTERN.md already says); type-checking of these test files (ts-jest compiled them with diagnostics, Vitest transforms with esbuild and checks no types, and no tsconfig covers the directory today); Node 24; a container build. docs/CONNECTORS_PATTERN.md still says the 20 files use Jest and goes stale on merge; it is not changed here. +
